newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo retreats from all-time high pre-R&D.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo retreats from all-time high pre-R&D.

text.p: Shares in Glaxo Wellcome Plc retreated on Thursday ahead of a research and development briefing for analysts and after setting a fresh all-time earlier in the week, dealers said.
Glaxo shares were down 17.5 pence, or 1.44 percent, to 1,196p by 1040 GMT in volume of 3.6 million while the FTSE-100 index was 2.7 points, or 6 percent, higher at 4438.7.
Glaxo was due to brief analysts on Friday in london and Monday in New York.

Analysts were expecting a positive outcome from the briefings. Glaxo on April 9 published promising results on a new drug for Hepatitis B, raising hopes it might have another huge seller on its hands, analysts said.
Glaxo's patent on leading ulcer drug Zantac runs out in June and generic rivals are set to enter the market.
Glaxo set a record closing high at 1,213.5p on Wednesday, after an intra-day peak at 1,215p.
